passages.note: A news quotation opposing the measure that names no deportation clause; the article's own line that he "voted against it" is the reporter's account, not a roll call.

rows.reasoning: The only passage is a news quotation in which Fernandez says HCR 2060 "will not make it safer, it will not save us money, it will costs us unnecessary and irreversible harm" - words that name no policy clause and so cannot reach any rung. The excerpt describes the measure as "allowing local law enforcement officers to arrest those who cross the border illegally", which is arrest at unlawful entry rather than the scope of removal the rungs separate ("Stop deportations entirely and protect undocumented immigrants from removal" through "Carry out a mass-deportation program to remove all undocumented immigrants"). The reported No vote is third-party characterization with no roll call in the sources, so no passage survives V1-V5.
